claim.statement: Google's current getting-started guide says a submitted Jules task generates a plan that the user can review and approve before code changes are made.

source.title: Jules getting started
source.locator: Starting your first task, steps 1-5 and final sentence

limitations: The statement describes the getting-started task flow and does not prove that every Jules invocation mode requires plan approval.
The catalog did not submit a task or test which side effects can occur before approval.
unknowns: Plan auto-approval, scheduled-task and API behavior are outside this claim's documented configuration.
The completeness of the plan relative to later file, command, network or tool actions is unknown.
